messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "carefully observe infants for breathing difficulties"
set: ["carefully observe infants for breathing difficulties", "carefully observe infants for limpness", "carefully observe infants for increased sleepiness", "carefully observe infants for increased sleepiness (more than usual)", "measure liquid medicine carefully", "carefully follow your doctor's instructions", "read and carefully follow any Instructions for Use provided with medicine", "follow all medication instructions very carefully", "carefully follow instructions about adjusting dose", "follow directions on prescription label carefully", "follow all dosing instructions very carefully", "treatment will need to be changed carefully", "do not exceed 37.5 mg a day for infants and children under 2 years", "follow your doctor's dosing instructions very carefully", "carefully follow the dosing instructions provided with children's ibuprofen for the age and weight of your child", "seek medical attention if breathing problems get worse quickly"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
